messages:
sam-sales: Hey team — Acme reported structured JSON responses are failing to parse on their side. They say the API returns text that looks like JSON but their parser errors with 'Invalid JSON'. Customer code path: embeddings -> prompt -> json_mode.

maria-support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw response body they got (not the post-processed one)? Also any request headers + example prompt?

sam-sales: Sure, sent the payload and response from Acme:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer ****

{
  "model": "open-llama-x",
  "mode": "json",
  "prompt": "Please output a JSON with key message. The message may contain quotes and newlines."
}
```
Response body (what they received):
```json
"{\n  \"message\": \"User said: \\\"Hello, world!\\\"\\nSecond line here\"\n}"
```
They said their parser sees the top-level thing as a string (note the outer quotes) and then unescaping produces an object but with broken newlines and double-escaped quotes.

alex-eng: Hmm — that response looks like we returned a JSON-encoded string rather than a raw object. Likely a mismatch between 'json_mode' handling in the runtime and the post-processing step that wraps streaming tokens. Two likely causes: (1) Our streaming output included code fences, and our JSON sanitizer wrapped the entire payload in a string to avoid breaking the client, or (2) the client set Content-Type incorrectly and the SDK double-encoded.

maria-support: Alex, any quick repro we can give Acme to run locally? They want to confirm it's on our side before we escalate billing/credits. Also their retry logic caused extra tokens and they asked about potential billing refunds.

alex-eng: Repro steps I asked them to try: (1) Hit our /v1/generate with header Accept: application/json and no SDK wrappers. (2) Use small prompt that returns simple JSON like: 
```json
{"message":"He said \"Hi\"\nNew line"}
```
(3) Ensure they don't wrap the body in a string when reading the response stream. If they still get an outer quoted string, collect the exact raw bytes.

sam-sales: They ran the raw curl and still got the quoted-string version. They attached raw bytes (I truncated):
```
22 7b 5c 6e 20 5c 22 6d 65 73 73 61 67 65 5c 22 3a 20 5c 22 55 73 65 72 20 73 61 69 64 3a 20 5c 5c 5c 22 48 65 6c 6c 6f 2c 20 77 6f 72 6c 64 21 5c 5c 5c 22 5c 6e 4e 65 78 74 20 6c 69 6e 65 5c 22 5c 6e 22 7d
```
That's hex for a JSON string with embedded escaped backslashes — looks double-escaped.

alex-eng: Thanks — that hex proves double-encoding. My hypothesis: when the model emits JSON inside a code fence (```json), our sanitizer strips the fences but also mistakenly applies JSON.stringify-like escaping on the whole output. There's an edge in the streaming path that wraps the final assembled text in extra quotes for safety. We'll add a quick fix: if mode==json and payload starts with '"{' or '"[', attempt a safe unquote-and-parse before returning. But need to be careful not to accept arbitrary strings.

maria-support: For the customer, meanwhile, recommended workaround?

alex-eng: Workaround for them: post-process by checking if body starts and ends with a double quote and the inner content parses as JSON after unescaping. Example (node):
```js
const raw = responseBody; // string
if (raw.startsWith('\"') && raw.endsWith('\"')) {
  const unquoted = JSON.parse(raw); // this will remove the outer quotes and unescape
  const obj = JSON.parse(unquoted);
  console.log(obj);
}
```
This is ugly but will let them continue while we push a runtime fix. Also ask them to disable any SDK auto-quoting flags.

maria-support: I'll send that and offer a one-week credit for the extra retries. Also cc'ing error-monitor-bot — any alerts triggered?

error-monitor-bot: alert: structured-output-parse-errors rate increased by 320% in us-west-2 between 2026-03-17T14:10:00Z and 2026-03-17T14:20:00Z. Top trace id: trace-0a7f3b.

alex-eng: I'll open an inc ticket and assign to eng-runtime. Quick mitigation: patch the sanitizer tonight to detect outer-string-wrapped JSON and strip once; then add e2e test to streaming path. I'll also add logging around prompt patterns that include quotes/backslashes so we can correlate.

maria-support: Thanks. Sam, I'll update Acme and file credit. Please attach any additional raw dumps if they rerun. :thumbsup:
